name: @fossil-lang/graph
description: In-process TS binding for the fossil-graph verb surface. Runs verb→SQL in WASM (fossil-graph-wasm) and delegates execution to a host-provided DuckDB-WASM query callback (e.g. keasy's Mosaic coordinator). The larger-than-RAM query layer for whatever draws the graph; fossil ships no viewer. Also publishes the corpus addressing — resolveCorpus turns a GraphAr manifest into tile URLs, synchronously and without WASM.
//exports: `.` is the verb surface and it needs the WASM: `client.js` and `load.js` both static-import `../pkg/fossil_graph_wasm.js`, so importing the root barrel instantiates nothing but does resolve it, and a consumer without that build output cannot load the module at all. `./address` is the addressing half, whose closure is `address.js` + `manifest.js` and nothing else — synchronous, WASM-free, no `query` callback. `./corpus` is the reference API, `openCorpus`, and it sits ON the addressing rather than absorbing it: its closure is `corpus.js` + those same two, because the engine it needs arrives as a callback instead of a dependency. Neither of those is a claim in a comment: `tests/address-standalone.test.ts` compiles each closure into a package directory with no `pkg/` in it and imports the subpath from a child Node process.

scripts.build: pnpm run build:wasm && pnpm run gen:types && tsc -p tsconfig.json
